notes.title: Introducing the Eel Boss!
notes.content:
Hello friends! It's David from Brave Lunch with another great update to Blobkin. Let's get right to it:
[list]
[*] [b]Added the Eel Boss![/b] This fearsome menace can be encountered after the Oil Rig map, lurking deep below the depths in that mysterious hole in front of you. He'll require excellent aiming and dodging skills to survive.
[*][b] Polished off Red Tide mode[/b], adding more enemies, waves, and power ups.
[*] [b]Optimized all the map's shadow maps[/b], ideally reducing a lot of processing overhead for GPUs.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could get stuck with just one enemy at a time attacking you, not a school/swarm.
[*] Fixed a bug where toxic guys were double counting your score and enemies killed.
[*] Reduced flashing of various particle fx that was giving players a headache; In particular the yellow effects. 
[/list]

The Eel was a big bad we are really excited about showing to the world. I can't wait for you to try him! As always, leave feedback and comments below. Happy hunting :)

:David

notes.title: Updated to 1.1.2!
notes.content:
Hello friends! Lots of bug fixes in this one, let's get right to it:

[list]
[*] • The OilRig and Pirate Cove level blockers have been fixed. There was an issue where if you didn't build something in time, or if you built it too early, the game would not progress. This bug was squashed!

[*] • The Scalloper, end boss, would occasionally glitch out and not do anything. Turns out he was just dozing off while on the job. We've since spoken to his manager and adjusted his schedule - Scalloper will now correctly react to player's shots and play his mini cinematics so that the game can progress.

[*] • The Tutorial Balloons during the Tutorial and Coral Reef levels were not firing, occasionally not informing you how to build at all. This has been fixed! Turns out the balloons were hiding.

[*] • An issue with Virtual Desktop controllers being pitched too much was reduced by using tender love and care to ensure that they lock onto your hand nicely.
[/list]

🥰

:David, co-creator

notes.title: Big Beta Boost! Fixed Index controller + much more 😁
notes.content:
Hello friends, fam, and fellow fish. I know it's Labor Day, and that means parents watching the one-year old while more furious programming is done!

Lots of big changes:

[list]
[*] The Weapons now stick to your hands. No more dropping 😅
[*] New Skip Tutorial button!
[*] And Switch Weapon sign, in case you want to swap which is your dominant hand 👋
[*] Hold down the trigger to fire your blaster! That should ease those trigger fingers... 👆
[*] Fixed a lot of reloading bugs, but there may still be edge cases 🤔
[*] Waves now properly end if you lose 🌊
[*] Enemies may be harder. Still tweaking the attack rates. Please let me know what you think! 🐡
[*] New intro music! Caleb our composer improved the way it feels and blends into the battle music 🎵
[/list]

But my favorite feature?

SMILING BLOBKIN!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37856864/2788f2d1a8e95cb6507ba60ae8604a5928143c0a.gif[/img]

They actually were always meant to smile, they're helping you protect the reef of course, but for some reason the animation wasn't firing correctly. It's all fixed :)

[h2]Do you want a key to help test? Come join our busy Discord, or send me an email! 😁

👉 Say hi in Discord:  https://discord.gg/SvxFPd5
👍 Or email me:  http://blobkinblaster.com/#email [/h2]

💧💙

PS. I'm documenting my adventures with our one-year old Seren in the form of a  [url=https://www.instagram.com/p/CE16txnjDVu/]webcomic...[/url]

notes.title: Beta Weekend Starts August 28th!
notes.content:
It has been a couple of months since our game update, but don’t worry, our little team is hard at work on Blobkin Blaster. We’ve taken the time to do a deep dive through all the code, removing legacy stuff from the gamejam that wasn’t up to performance. No one likes low FPS and crashes! Here's the kind of [url=https://twitter.com/bravelunch/status/1289011990627835904]spaghetti we were dealing with (old on the right!)[/url].

We’ve also reworked all the game systems - this means adding new enemies, items and weapons should happen a lot faster now! [url=https://twitter.com/bravelunch/status/1291762376711307264]Such as a new artillery cannon[/url]!

Now onto bigger news:
[h1]BETA WEEKEND is Coming! Happening August 28th[/h1]
[h2]To sign up, please join our [url=https://www.bravelunch.com/blobkin-blaster#email]mailing list[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/SvxFPd5]Discord[/url] as we’ll hand out keys there :)
[/h2]

For now, please enjoy the current demo available! As always, email me with feedback and questions (david@bravelunch.com) or hit me up on Discord :D

💙💧

notes.title: An Update from the Reef #1 + Beta Weekend in August! 🤿🔫
notes.content:
Hello friends, fans (and hi mom!)

Our team over here at Brave Lunch is hungrily banging the keyboard at making Blobkin Blaster! We've got a new pistol blaster (your main starting weapon), plus we've got XP and level progression built in! Woohoo! Let's take a look:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37856864/d304c154deb722d4a6e31b4fcd0e3967c712c2cc.gif[/img]

Plus, there's a new weapon we're working ([url=https://twitter.com/bravelunch/status/1285274651476791297]potentially inspired by this[/url]). And we've been refining the wave mechanics so you don't get swarmed immediately.

Our goal is by the end of August to have a BETA WEEKEND! Play the first level, blow up monsters, and enjoy the calming rhythm of the sea :)

That is... until the clam boss shows up!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37856864/0d9f0abd7484369168d2c7b5734cbd4d1e84cb76.jpg[/img]

All of this has made us think, there should be a new genre of game out there.. SCUBA Shooter! It's like an FPS, but with underwater physics!

See you at the reef real soon. 💙💧

-

[h2]Do you have a Discord? Do you enjoy pictures of pets and babies? Then come join us! -> [url=https://discord.gg/SvxFPd5]https://discord.gg/SvxFPd5[/url][/h2]
